svg.title: A uniform local chart retains a partition Q into disjoint nonempty parts, length s > 0, collapsed offset, linear resizing frame A and a closed stage in a fixed bounded resized set. Part radii Ri ∈ (0, 1] scale their normal directions. A common detector collar B ∈(0, 1] contains the normal extent and subtraction halo, with 2s ≤B; nonsingleton radii are at most a fixed multiple of s. Require B ≤clearance(P j dj), decreasing with degree and hence covering all projection degrees. The continuation of other groups, centers and fields is constant along each current part’s normal directions. Ancestor-subtracted expressions are thus retained as exterior continuations with their cancellations intact. Refine a nonsingleton i by proper partition U on an angular annular patch, with new radius a and other radii fixed. Compose A with normal multiplication by a/Ri, identity on N⊥ i . Then | det A′| = | det A|(a/Ri)νi. (CE5)
